status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Neon glow
summary: Electric edges and focused light on a deep, quiet canvas.
use_when: Use for launch moments, interactive showcases, and technology campaigns.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
layout: Dark negative space, concentrated highlights, a single luminous focal point.
surfaces: Cyan edge lighting, dark panels, and tightly controlled glow.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Neon glow to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with bold headings. Dark negative space, concentrated highlights, a single luminous focal point. Cyan edge lighting, dark panels, and tightly controlled glow. Palette: background #080c19, surface #11182a, text #f4faff, muted #b7c8dc, accent #89fbea, border #496477. Essential traits: Luminous cyan borders; Dark stable reading surfaces; One accented action. Avoid: Glow on body text; Flashing effects; Multiple competing neon colors. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
